FN-GJDV2CC-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 7
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Representative Juandalynn Givan
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 03/04/2024
House Bill 7 as introduced could increase receipts to the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency
(ALEA) by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of fees collected for any
background checks administered by ALEA for certain apartment employees.
